headline: No Dogs in Space is a music history podcast for true obsessives
summary: Music history podcast "No Dogs in Space" has been dormant since July 2024. Season three focused on experimental rock, concluding an abbreviated season. Fans enjoyed prior seasons and anticipated more content.

headline: Zuckerberg’s yacht was closer, but someone else saved a stranded boat
summary: A stranded boat in Farragut Bay was rescued by the Wilderness Legacy cruise ship. Mark Zuckerberg's super yacht, Launchpad, was actually closer to the incident. A passenger documented the rescue online.

headline: 49ers coach says his Tesla was on Autopilot when he crashed
summary: 49ers coach Kyle Shanahan was involved in a car crash four weeks ago. He initially admitted fault for the accident. Shanahan later disclosed his Tesla's Autopilot was active at the time.

headline: Dropbox is a PC builder’s best friend
summary: A designer risked his reputation on a crowdfunded game project in 2018. He worried about losing all local work on his custom-built PC. Dropbox proved invaluable for backing up his critical project data.

headline: One Night Only Director Cut 'So Much Nudity' from Film Because Audiences Now Dislike Seeing It
summary: Director Will Gluck removed significant nudity from his film "One Night Only". He believes contemporary audiences are uncomfortable with on-screen nudity. The decision reflects changing viewer preferences regarding explicit content.

headline: House of the Dragon Season 3 Ending Explained and Book Differences
summary: The House of the Dragon Season 3 finale is explained in detail. Key betrayals, deaths, and dragon devastation are analyzed. Significant differences between the show and the book "Fire & Blood" are highlighted.

headline: House of the Dragon Season 3 Finale Recap and Review
summary: A recap and review of the House of the Dragon Season 3 finale is provided. The episode, despite a spectacular battle, doesn't offer a definitive conclusion. It effectively sets the stage for the upcoming final season.

headline: Warner Bros. Stirs Controversy After Posting 'Embarrassing' AI Dog Podcast for The End of Oak Street
summary: Warner Bros. is facing criticism for an "embarrassing" AI dog podcast promotion. The controversial podcast was created to market the film "The End of Oak Street." The movie stars Ewan McGregor and Anne Hathaway.

headline: Travelodge staff gave domestic abuser key to his victim's room
summary: A woman claims Travelodge staff provided her abuser with a key to her hotel room. Her attacker subsequently kicked the door off its hinges. The incident raises serious concerns about hotel security protocols.

headline: Burnham brings forward ban on 'subscription traps' to ease cost of living
summary: The prime minister is initiating a UK tour to address living costs. A key announcement includes bringing forward a ban on "subscription traps." This measure aims to help ease financial burdens for consumers.

headline: Thames Water gave finance boss a £1m signing-on fee
summary: Thames Water awarded finance boss Steve Buck a £1 million signing-on fee. The seven-figure payment was part of his recruitment package. This occurred despite the utility company's troubled financial state.

headline: Evidence that South African special forces murdered top detective shared with BBC
summary: Top detective Frans Mathipa was fatally shot while driving. Evidence suggesting South African special forces murdered him has been shared with the BBC. The BBC accessed the prosecution's case against eight accused individuals.
